identityRefresh.why: The census has now been rewritten around this receipt's anchors three times. The receipt was pinned at 4d0eb74bbafe6ee3 while the file on disk stood at f6fc081419eadf60, so allSourcesExact true was a false statement about this receipt's own custody and a rebuild could not reproduce it. This lane re-did the comparison across the WHOLE drift rather than carrying the previous annotation forward: all three historical blobs were recovered from the repository - 0936833332542f8e at commit 39b88c674, 9816a479e532017f at commit ecd2bde79 and 4d0eb74bbafe6ee3 at commit 2d01b84f7 - and the single census entry this receipt binds, the one whose routeKey is obligation:runtime-only:WV:sex-trafficking-victim-vacatur-and-expungement, was serialised with sorted keys and compared object-for-object against the bytes on disk at f6fc081419eadf60. It is identical at all four identities, at the same array index routes[93], 2823 characters in each. The three anchor statements this build relies on are present on disk; the builder refuses if any is missing and it did not refuse. The bound content has not moved; only the whole-file identity has, three times. This is a re-pin, not a re-source: nothing was re-acquired and no page moved a byte.
